## bh-p01 — veneration Bhairava-Lord, refuge of the helpless — by mind become Yours, in heart I venerate. The stotra opens with the devotee's stance: total surrender of mind to Bhairava, who is the refuge of those without refuge.
studio chant · rathoddhata · align 0.904

tvanmayametadaśeṣamidānīṃ bhāti mama tvadanugrahaśaktyā

## bh-p03 — suffering acknowledged Even though hard-to-bear suffering, delusion, and terror-causing karmas are present — the devotee does not flinch. The reality of suffering is acknowledged, not denied.
studio chant · rathoddhata · align 0.907

शङ्करसेवनचिन्तनधीरो भीषणभैरवशक्तिमयोस्मि

śaṅkarasevanacintanadhīro bhīṣaṇabhairavaśaktimayo'smi
## bh-p04 — power-filled By Śaṅkara-service, firm in contemplation, I am filled with terrifying Bhairava-power. Service and firm contemplation produce the power-filled state.
studio chant · rathoddhata · align 0.949

## bh-p05 — fearlessness Death, Yama, the ender, karma-ghosts — Lord, salutation; never do I fear. Salutation to the Lord removes all fear of death and danger.
studio chant · rathoddhata · align 0.94

## bh-p06 — bliss In being-full in You — I, the self, enter bliss. Bliss is entering the fullness of the Lord.
studio chant · rathoddhata · align 0.907

## bh-p07 — nondifference and hymn-rain Lord, then alone is my nondifference with You; the supreme-nectar-rain of the hymn arises. Nondifference manifests when the hymn-rain arises.
studio chant · rathoddhata · align 0.95

## bh-p08 — scripture-contemplation Your scripture's supreme-nectar-contemplation in the mind — the bliss-stream flows. Contemplating scripture produces the bliss-stream in mind.
